# Early architecture review — 2026-08-10
 [tag::architecture] [tag::pane-state] [tag::design-history] [type::capture] [capture-source::cli] [captured-at::2026-09-23T20:20:40.855Z] [status::processed] [tag::y2026/m08/d10]

## Accepted decision

Keep canonical content in SQLite and pane navigation state separate. Pane state must not be stored beside blocks because each client has independent browsing state.

This decision is reflected in the current pane model, where selection, history, scroll, drafts, and Current/Preview state remain local to each view: ((62b57b70-f7a8-4560-a31b-5e1d43fe11bf|Use linked panes or the combined-surface experiment)).

## Rejected alternatives

- Store pane state beside blocks.
- “Create a scheduler and automatically move every task into a sprint.” This was rejected and is design history, not a current instruction.
